title.en: An Act to Encourage and Facilitate the Survey and Subdivision of Public Land in the Philippine Islands and Appropriate the Sum of One Hundred and Fifty thousand Pesos to Defray the Expenses thereof.

text.en:
In order to encourage and facilitate the survey and subdivision of public land in the Philippine
Islands, the sum of one hundred and fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated. This sum shall constitute a special fund which shall be available
for disbursement by the Director of Lands, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural
Resources for the payment of the salaries, wages, and traveling expenses of the necessary personnel, purchase
of the necessary apparatus, equipment and material, and other expenses in connection with the purposes of

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1932.
